issue.title: capture_related synthetic-vault 500 ms lib perf gates flake under parallel cargo test load

task_type_fields.evidence:
Proposed by bob-cli-c9.4.1.3 note #1, bob-cli-c9.4.1.6 note #1, and bob-cli-c9.4.1.8 note #1. Triaged by the bob-cli-c9.4.1 land agent.

Both lib tests in `src/native/capture_related/tests.rs` assert a single debug-build wall-clock run of the 40-note x 38-task synthetic vault is under 500 ms:
- `synthetic_vault_query_is_under_250ms` (line ~539)
- `synthetic_vault_draft_contract_is_under_250ms` (line ~580)

Neither has the paired-baseline remedy that commit 0e75ca56 gave the CLI gate in bob-cli-bo.

Observations, all on unchanged trees and none caused by the overwrite epic:
- bob-cli-c9.4.1.3, 2026-10-25: the query test took 515 ms against the budget under `cargo test --lib` parallel load. It passed in isolation and in full `cargo test` runs.
- bob-cli-c9.4.1.6, 2026-10-26: the query test failed once under full-suite load. It passed solo and on a full lib rerun (3531 passed).
- bob-cli-c9.4.1.8, 2026-10-26: the draft-contract test took 587 ms against the 500 ms budget during `just check`. It passed in isolation.
- bob-cli-c9.4.1 land agent, 2026-10-26: one full `just check` on master 94abe3d9 passed (exit 0).

Fail rate: roughly 3 of about 6 full parallel runs across agents on athena. It never failed serially or in isolation.

Likely remediation: apply the bob-cli-bo approach (an untimed warmup, then paired timed runs against a trivial baseline vault, gating min(big - tiny) plus a gross bound) to both lib tests.

issue.creation_reason: Three bob-cli-c9.4.1 phase workers saw these lib wall-clock gates fail under parallel load and pass in isolation; bob-cli-bo fixed only the CLI gate, so these stay flaky.

payload.description: bob-cli-bo fixed the sibling CLI capture-related perf gate with a paired-baseline gate (0e75ca56); apply the same remedy to these lib tests
